deprecated.description: Lowercase deprecated input IDs and their messages. An empty message still means deprecated.

inputs.description: Declared input names with original casing. Lookups are case-insensitive.

name.description: Action display name from its manifest.

outputs.description: Declared output names with original casing.

required.description: Lowercase input IDs required from callers (required inputs with defaults are excluded).

runtime.description: Runtime needed for validation; omitted when no runtime check is recorded.

skipInputs.description: Allow arbitrary inputs instead of checking declarations.

skipOutputs.description: Allow arbitrary outputs instead of checking declarations.

title: Bundled action catalogue
description: Offline validation metadata. Exact action references select shared definitions; unknown references are not inferred.

definitions.description: Identical validation definitions are stored once. Reference targets are checked by the catalogue loader.

references.description: Exact owner/repository[/path]@ref keys mapped to definition IDs. IDs are representative references, not version ranges.

retired.description: Exact references whose runtime or service is retired. These must not also occur in references.

version.description: Catalogue format version, not an action version.
